label: Nextdoor Ads
terms_note: Ads API access is by application ("Apply for access") on developer.nextdoor.com

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (Nextdoor Ads API) Confidence: **high** — official portal read (endpoint list via OpenAPI TODO(verify)).
auth: 1. Create a developer account and 'Apply for access' to the Advertise product.
2. OAuth2 app credentials → advertiser authorization → token.
3. Campaigns → ad groups → ads → scheduled reports; conversion API for attribution.
reference.limits: - Access by application; free; Nextdoor developer terms.

fields.name: api_token
fields.help: Nextdoor Ads Manager API token (NAM > settings > API, https://ads.nextdoor.com/v2/manage/api) for an account granted Ads API access; one token per user, valid for one year, acting for every advertiser tied to the NAM account.

config_fields.name: advertiser_id
config_fields.help: Nextdoor advertiser id used by pause_resume (the status path is /api/v3/advertisers/{advertiserId}/campaigns/{campaignId}/status).

me.note: GET /api/v3/me: {profile {id, name, is_ad_agency}, user {id, email, advertisers_with_access [{id, role}]}}.

list_accounts.note: The advertisers the token's user can reach, from GET /api/v3/me (user.advertisers_with_access: id and role only; names and currency come from GET /api/v3/advertisers/{id}).

list_campaigns.note: GET /api/v3/advertisers/{advertiserId}/campaigns?pageSize= (archived excluded). `status` is the computed status (ACTIVE, PAUSED, NO_ACTIVE_AD_GROUPS, PAUSED_FOR_BILLING…; raw.data.user_status is the user setting) and is not a filter here. Budgets live on ad groups. Cursor paging: only the first page is returned.

pause_resume.note: PUT /api/v3/advertisers/{advertiser_id config}/campaigns/{campaign_id}/status {user_status: PAUSED|ACTIVE}; returns the updated campaign. Resuming restarts spending on its ad groups.

not_offered.get_report: Synchronous stats ("GET /api/v3/advertisers/{advertiserId}/stats" and ".../campaigns/{campaignId}/stats", https://developer.nextdoor.com/reference/get_api-v3-advertisers-advertiserid-stats) return a single totals object rather than rows, which the adapter's list mapping cannot wrap; row reports ("POST /api/v3/advertisers/{advertiserId}/reports") are generated asynchronously.
not_offered.update_budget: Nextdoor budgets are set on ad groups ("PUT /api/v3/advertisers/{advertiserId}/adgroups/{adGroupId}", https://developer.nextdoor.com/reference/put_api-v3-advertisers-advertiserid-adgroups-adgroupid); campaigns carry no budget field.

evidence: probe: 4/4 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 200 (public), so the answers are path-specific
